name: Numata Youko
source:
Receiving the cruel jeers of her peers and terrifying photographs from her stalker, she committed suicide. Once glimpsed by a youkai that incites suicide, her road to self-destruction was accelerated. Since the spirit of one that commits suicide is beloved by the youkai, there was no peace after death for her. Made the plaything of the youkai, she endlessly wanders the bottom of a freezing hell.

[SPOILER]
Her stalker was revealed to be Nonomiya Takeshi, who was the one Youko's friends framed for breaking some school equipment. In revenge, Takeshi set out to frighten Youko by stalking her and sending her terrifying pictures. Youko eventually committed suicide.

She was pulled out of hell and was initially planning to exact her revenge on Takeshi, but the two came to forgive one another. Thanks to Higanbana, Youko's spirit was freed and she could finally rest.
[/SPOILER]

[Based on the English translation of her unlockable profile.]
